description: This file defines the JsonKeyInvalidException, a specialized runtime exception thrown when a JSON key has an invalid format. It includes builder methods for creating exception instances with specific messages or descriptions.

classes.name: JsonKeyInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing exceptions for invalid JSON keys, extending JsonRuntimeException, with builder methods for constructing instances with specific messages or descriptions.

classes.name: JsonKeyInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating instances of JsonKeyInvalidException, allowing setting of JSON pointer messages and building the exception object.

methods.name: JsonKeyInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating JsonKeyInvalidException instances.

methods.name: JsonKeyInvalidException.newBuilderWithDescription
methods.description: Creates a builder with a custom message about the invalid JSON key and an optional description.

methods.name: JsonKeyInvalidException.newBuilderWithoutDescription
methods.description: Creates a builder with a default message indicating the JSON key is invalid.

methods.name: Builder.jsonPointer
methods.description: Sets a message pointing to the invalid JSON key, formatting it into a standard error message.
